sources.document: AMD Am29861-64 High Performance Bus Transceivers (03369B), in AMD 1985 Bipolar Microprocessor Logic and Interface Data Book

electrical.notes: Commercial IOL 48 mA (VOL 0.5 V); VOH 2.4 V at -15 mA, 2.0 V at -24 mA. Input hysteresis 200 mV min on the data pins (minimum, not typical). ICC up to 160 mA (page 8-61).

unknown: The hysteresis threshold voltages are not given (only the 200 mV minimum width): vtPlusV and vtMinusV are null.
The function table does not cover /OET and /OER both low at once (both sides driving).
notes: Commercial maximums over the operating range, CL 50 pF: R to T or T to R 7.0 ns (PLH), 7.5 ns (PHL); enable 15 ns; disable 9 ns at CL 5 pF (page 8-62). CL 300 pF figures are on the same page. No minimum delays given.
